item.title: Emilia Clarke founded SameYou after brain haemorrhages; it has raised £3.8m and helped 1,200+ survivors
item.description: In 2019, Emilia Clarke established SameYou, a charity dedicated to enhancing rehabilitation options for brain injury survivors. With over £3.8 million raised, the initiative has positively impacted more than 1,200 lives. One of its key offerings, NeuroRehabilitation Online, utilizes teletherapy to connect patients with qualified therapists. By focusing on the crucial recovery phase post-hospital, SameYou strives to fill significant gaps in patient care, garnering accolades for its innovative support approaches. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
